James Joyce
AI-adapted light-plaster ornament after Marjorie Fitzgibbon's 1982 bust. Reference photograph by Illustratedjc, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Adaptation: background removed, material and plinth changed, proportions and lighting reinterpreted. Not a documentary image of the sculpture.
